info.headline: Red Alert: Severe Heatwave Conditions with Temperatures Exceeding 47C in Churu
info.description: Maximum day temperatures expected to cross 47 degrees Celsius with severe loo wind conditions. High probability of heat stroke and dehydration among vulnerable population.
info.instruction: Avoid direct sunlight exposure between 12 PM and 4 PM. Drink ORS, buttermilk, and clean water frequently. Keep domestic animals sheltered and hydrated in cool shaded areas.
